profileLabel: Center-left economics (medium confidence); pro-transparency institutions (low confidence)
summary: Camarines Sur 5th District representative with 187 principal-authored bills. Authored free anti-rabies vaccination, an excise tax on plastic bags, a higher SEF rate, a strategic petroleum reserve, the national minimum wage, estate tax amnesty extension, medical cannabis access, a right-to-information act and a digital budget portal.
caveat: Medical cannabis is a single social issue and not scored. Bill-based; no votes.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored free anti-rabies vaccination (-2), the national minimum wage (-2), a strategic petroleum reserve (-1) and plastic-bag excise and higher SEF rate (-1). Estate tax amnesty neutral. Four issues, bill-based.
